name: Vasco
description:
Vasco is the revenue context graph that sits under your AI. It connects the systems that already hold most of your revenue context. It gives them one schema, one set of identities, and one set of definitions. This connector opens that graph to Claude.

Claude reasons well on what it can read. It cannot know what an SQL means at your company. It cannot know that a Stripe customer and a HubSpot company are the same account. It cannot know your target for the quarter. It cannot know that the last four deals with this pattern were lost. None of that lives in your data, so no model will infer it.

Vasco holds it. Identities are resolved, so one account is one account. Definitions are authored by you, so a metric means the same thing every time. The plan is loaded, so every number arrives with its target and its variance. Outcomes are tagged, so today's deal is compared against the ones that already closed.

This connector hands all four to Claude. Every metric Claude returns carries a source and a definition you wrote. Claude traces a number back to the signal that moved it. It reads and writes your ICPs, your source mappings, and your go-to-market team model. You stay the author. Claude reasons on what you defined, not on what it inferred.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vasco to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vasco to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vasco.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vasco MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vasco lists 62 MCP tools, including assign_position, delete_channel, delete_custom_dimension, delete_customer_account_merge, delete_employee, delete_employee_mapping, delete_expense_type, delete_function, delete_icp, delete_motion, delete_position, and delete_position_period.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vasco?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vasco in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Vasco requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vasco is developed by Vasco. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
